title: Mushroom Zucchini Noodles
description: High-volume chicken noodle stir-fry with mushrooms, zucchini and tomatoes in a simple soy sauce — the ultimate filling low-calorie bowl.

ingredients.text: 80g dry thin wheat noodles or egg noodles

steps: Cook noodles; drain. Chop mushrooms, zucchini, onion and tomatoes. Cut chicken into strips.
Fry chicken in 2g oil 1 min per side; season with salt and pepper; remove.
Sauté mushrooms with 50g water; once collapsed add 2g oil; brown 4–5 min. Add zucchini and onion; fry 3 min. Add tomatoes; fry 2 min. Remove.
Add noodles to pan; stir-fry 1 min.
Return chicken and vegetables; add soy sauce; toss 30 sec. Done.
notes: Originally made with shirataki noodles (10 kcal/100g). Swapped for 80g dry wheat noodles (~280 kcal). Macros adjusted accordingly. Add cornstarch slurry for a thicker sauce.
